title: Invoices sent from a chat
disclaimer: Illustration · Claw, Fastbooks, and all companies, people, and amounts are made up

story.overview: Jordan asks Claw to invoice October's completed jobs. Claw uses its Fastbooks connector to create and email three invoices, and they appear in Fastbooks Online.
story.description: Small businesses lose hours each month turning finished jobs into invoices. This film shows an AI assistant doing it through a connector: one request in chat, each connector call the assistant makes, and the finished invoices waiting in the accounting app.
workflow: Jordan turns on the Fastbooks connector in Claw
Jordan asks Claw to invoice October's completed jobs
Claw lists the completed jobs through the connector
Claw creates an invoice for each customer and emails them
The three invoices appear in Fastbooks Online, marked Sent

chapters.title: Connect Fastbooks
chapters.narration: Jordan connects Claw to Fastbooks in one click.

chapters.title: Ask Claw
chapters.narration: Then asks Claw to invoice the month's completed jobs.

steps.prompt: Create invoices for October's completed jobs and email them to each customer.

chapters.title: Claw uses the connector
chapters.narration: Claw finds the jobs, creates three invoices, and sends them through Fastbooks.

steps.result: 3 completed jobs · Acme Corp, Globex, Initech

steps.respond:

chapters.title: In Fastbooks
chapters.narration: In Fastbooks Online, the new invoices are already there, marked Sent.

chapters.title: Recap
chapters.narration: One request in Claw, three invoices in Fastbooks, no copy-paste.
